desc:
✨ DISCOVER AVATAR ✨
Explore the Roblox catalog, try on items, and put together your own outfits! 👗🧢

🛍️ SHOP THE CATALOG
Browse hats, hair, clothes, emotes, and more. Try things on for free, then buy an item or a whole outfit when you’re ready!

🎨 MAKE IT YOURS
Move, rotate, and resize your accessories. Change your body scale and save your favorite outfits to your closet! 👚

💃 EMOTES & MUSIC
Try out emotes before buying them and listen to music while you shop! 🎶

👯 CLONES
Make clones of yourself, dress them up, switch between outfits, and mess around with them!

📸 SHARE YOUR STYLE
Post your outfits and photos, add hashtags, get likes ❤️, and follow other stylists!

🪙 EARN REWARDS
Get coins back when you buy items, plus daily streak and playtime bonuses. Level up by playing, exploring, and sharing your outfits! 🏆

👀 Find new outfits, discover trending looks, and get inspired!

👍 Like outfits, ⭐ favorite items, and come back every day for bonus coins!

[BETA - Expect Bugs]
